sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:60

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:60:1
items.html: When Olam Beria rises to Olam Atzilut Beria returns to being in the degree of Atzilut. This is very simple. There is no issue of imaginary places here, but of quality of merit. When you say that the Tachton rises to the place of the Elyon it means that its Tzura has been equalized with the Elyon. Hence, it is necessary that when Beria rises to the place of Atzilut it becomes exactly like Atzilut, and remember that in all the places.
